note: Japan's national spirits. The ones with `start` describe the situation on 1 January 2000 and cite sources. Values are gameplay estimates.

spirits.name: The Lost Decade
spirits.description: The economy has stagnated since the asset price bubble collapsed in 1990, and public debt keeps rising.

spirits.name: An ageing society
spirits.description: The population is ageing faster than in any other nation.

spirits.name: Article 9
spirits.description: The constitution renounces war as a means of settling international disputes.

source.title: Wikipedia: Article 9 of the Japanese Constitution

spirits.name: The US alliance
spirits.description: The security treaty with the United States has been in effect since 23 June 1960.

source.title: Wikipedia: Treaty of Mutual Cooperation and Security between the United States and Japan

spirits.name: Abenomics
spirits.description: Monetary easing, fiscal stimulus and structural reform.

spirits.name: Collective self-defence
spirits.description: The forces may defend allies in certain situations.

spirits.name: After Fukushima
spirits.description: Most reactors are shut and the disaster zone is being rebuilt.
